outbreaks.summary: Authorities are investigating parents for potential involuntary manslaughter by omission after their child died from diphtheria in Palermo, Italy, as the child had not received the mandatory vaccination.
Mozambique's measles outbreak has accumulated 2,595 measles cases and 4 deaths from July 2025 to August 2026, including a surge in recent cases.
In Russia's Tyumen region, 36 people contracted measles during the first six months of 2026.
Between May and August 2026, 293 measles cases were confirmed in Peru's Arequipa region.
One new polio case was detected in Niger, the country's first in 2026.
Three polio cases were detected in Sudan, bringing this year's total to 4.
Four new wild polio cases were reported in Afghanistan, bringing this year's total to 19.
Five polio cases were detected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, bringing this year's total to 32.
Two polio cases were detected in Nigeria, bringing the total to 41 in 2026.
Bangladesh's measles outbreak has reached 18,726 confirmed cases and 955 deaths.
Sweden has reported 21 measles cases, linked to a music festival.
Erbil, Iraq has registered 70 cases of measles in the past 2 weeks.

The death toll from Bangladesh's measles outbreak surpassed 900, and the country's confirmed case count for 2026 reached 17,800.
Senegal's Kédougou region identified 591 suspected diphtheria cases, three of which were confirmed, between May and August 2026, with several child deaths under investigation.
A community measles outbreak in Mallorca, Spain, has affected six people and been linked to a child tourist who was identified as the index case.
Nigeria's Niger State reported 124 confirmed diphtheria cases and 17 deaths in 2026.

With 94 new measles infections this week across the United States, mostly in Pennsylvania, the nationwide total for the year has reached 2,465.

In the Gaza Strip, there have been more than 58,000 cases of chickenpox this year.
Brazil has reported 16 measles cases in 2026, with 13 in São Paulo.
Afghanistan has reported 15 polio cases in 2026, while the broader Eastern Mediterranean region has reported 18 cases in total this year.
Pakistan reported 46 confirmed diphtheria cases and 10 deaths so far in 2026.
Kostanay, Kazakhstan, has reported 167 measles cases in 2026, an increase of 157 cases from the same period in 2025.
Pakistan reported 3,025 measles cases and 59 deaths so far in 2026.

The death toll from the ongoing measles outbreak in Bangladesh has reached 847, with three additional deaths reported in the past 24 hours and and 16,408 confirmed cases.

There are currently nine confirmed cases of measles in El Salvador, primarily among doctors, patients, family members, and other individuals connected to hospitals and medical centers across the country.

Yemen has reported 1,624 measles cases this year, including 290 laboratory-confirmed cases and 12 deaths.

A total of 32 cases of whooping cough have been confirmed in Kazakhstan this year, all among children under the age of 14.

Seven children in the Samara Region have been diagnosed with whooping cough this year, bringing the country’s annual total case count to 10.

A four-case measles outbreak in Tenerife is believed to have originated from a child visiting from the United Kingdom.

Los Angeles County, California confirmed a measles case passing through the Los Angeles International Airport, bringing the county's total to six cases in 2026.
Afghanistan has reported two new polio cases in the past week, bringing the country's total for 2026 to six cases.

Haiti reported 159 confirmed diphtheria cases as of May 2026, more than double the number of cases reported during the same period in 2025.
Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, reported four new measles cases in the past week, bringing the county’s 2026 total to 40 cases.
Utah has reported 482 measles cases so far in 2026, the second-highest total in the nation, as childhood vaccination rates continue to drop.
In Lakes State, South Sudan, a measles outbreak has resulted in 145 reported cases and 11 deaths this year, primarily affecting Cueibet County.
Following Spartanburg County's outbreak that began in October 2025, two new confirmed cases in Beaufort Country and Hampton County bring South Carolina's total to almost 1,000 cases.
Two children have died from measles in England in 2026, and the total number of laboratory-confirmed cases has reached 736 in England so far this year.
With a new measles case confirmed in Buckingham County, Virginia's outbreak reached 106 this year.
Argentina has reported 298 cases of whooping cough this year, well above the historical baseline 76 cases in past years.
Eight more children died of measles in Bangladesh, bringing this year's death toll to 628.
Mexico's measles outbreak has reached 11,748 confirmed cases in 2026, mainly affecting infants, children, and young adults.
Malawi has detected one new vaccine-derived polio case (cVDPV2) as of June 2, the country's first in 2026.
Central African Republic has detected two new vaccine-derived polio cases (cVDPV2) as of June 2, the country's first in 2026.
Maldives has reported 11 measles cases in 2026; six were recorded in May.
Nigeria has detected two new vaccine-derived polio cases (cVDPV2) as of June 2, bringing its 2026 total to 31 cases.
This year, the United States has recorded 2,030 measles cases as of June 2026, already nearing the total for all of 2025.
Peru's measles outbreak in Puno continues to worsen, with cases increasing to 446 in 2026.
